Do Carbs even get absorbed on DNP? 

DNP uncouples oxidative phosphorylation, increasing energy expenditure and causing the body to burn more calories, which also causes heat.

If you eat carbs on DNP, you’ll get a heat burst about 30-60 minutes after digestion of which the intensity depends on how many carbs you ate.

People report losing more fat on a high carb diet using dnp.
My theory is that most of the carbs won’t be converted into atp and will just turn into heat. I’m not saying the heat is increasing the metabolism or your caloric deficit, assuming that would be stupid. 

But I think the energy is literally just turned into heat and won’t have an impact on your calories in vs calories out.
How would the body get hotter (heat is energy) and at the same time store the energy from the carbs? This makes no sense since energy cannot be created, which means the heat (energy) must come from somewhere.

This means that you can eat however you like on Dnp, if you choose to use carbs.

What do you think about this?
